title: Specify kernel operating levels
acceptance: Defines the level set decided in D-11 and the Host AI capability matrix each level is derived from.
States the cap rule: the effective level is the lowest of the requested level, the allowed level and the level the verified capabilities support.
States that capability is tested, not self-declared, is tested once per Host AI profile and is re-tested when something changes.
Keeps the three axes separate and cross-references the platform-profile and conformance-level definitions.
Resolves CTR-O-05, CTR-O-06 and RTM-O-17, or records deferrals permitted by D-10.
